title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
summary: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.
reason: OpenAI's National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint is corporate policy advocacy, not a government policy action (R4-1 excludes self-regulation/commentary), nor a model release, research artifact, business event, or OSS tool. No active rule covers it.
